title: Q2 Roadmap Readout & Board Packet Preparation — Exec QBR and Monthly Update
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Prepare the Q2 roadmap readout materials for the executive QBR and board packet. Scope includes finalizing slides, one-pager for board, risk register, topline metrics vs OKRs, demo plan for Dedicated performance improvements, and alignment with Sales/Customer Success talking points. Deliverables: 1) 12-15 slide exec deck, 2) 1-page board summary, 3) risk & mitigation appendix, 4) product demo script + recording link, 5) publish summary to Confluence and circulate to execs. Key goals: clarify trade-offs on batching/quantization rollout, show latency/cost delta for Redwood Dedicated, and surface any customer-impacting feature toggles planned for Q2.

This ticket coordinates cross-functional work (Engineering, Design, Solutions, Sales, Legal) and tracks approvals for final packet. Use meeting notes and draft links below for collaboration.
